description.zh: 集群ID，可通过调用GetK8sCluster接口获取，请参见[GetK8sCluster](~~181437~~)。
description.en: The ID of the ACK cluster or serverless Kubernetes cluster. You can obtain the cluster ID by calling the GetK8sCluster operation. For more information, see [GetK8sCluster](~~181437~~).

description.zh:
是否开启ASM：
- true：开启
- false：不开启
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the integration with Alibaba Cloud Service Mesh (ASM). Valid values:

- true: Enables the integration with ASM.

- false: Disables the integration with ASM.

description.zh: 命名空间ID。格式为“`地域ID:微服务空间标识符`”，例如：`cn-hangzhou:doc`。
description.en: The ID of the namespace. It is in the format of `Region ID:Identifier of the microservices namespace`. Example: `cn-hangzhou:doc`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas import-k8s-cluster --cluster-id 9c28bbb9-0000-44b3-b953-54ef8a2d0be2 --namespace-id cn-beijing:doc --biz-mode 1 --enable-asm true --region cn-hangzhou
